name: Resultado de la verificación
trigger: Only when the identity verification procedure hands off here after calling verify_identity. Never start it from a customer request.

steps.instruction: Thank the customer by first name and tell them their identity is verified, then continue with what they asked for.

fallback.message: No pude verificar tu identidad con esos datos. Por tu seguridad no puedo compartir información de la cuenta. Puedes volver a llamarnos cuando tengas tus datos a la mano. Gracias por llamar.

en.value: I couldn't verify your identity with that information. For your security I can't share any account details. You can call us again when you have your details at hand. Thank you for calling.
